You're Not Failing at Leadership. You're Using the Wrong Mode.

Leadership, management and mentoring are three modes one person switches between, often in the same week, not three separate roles. People rarely fail because they lack one of them. They fail because they use the wrong mode at the wrong moment, like mentoring someone who needed a clear decision.

Most people are promoted for being good at the work and trained only in the mechanics of management. This course builds leadership and mentoring deliberately, with a three-question diagnostic, exercises and discussion questions, and sources for every cited idea.

What you get

  • Module 1: Three modes, not three roles
  • Module 2: Diagnosing the moment
  • Module 3: Leading
  • Module 4: Managing, including warning signs of over- and under-managing
  • Module 5: Mentoring
  • Module 6: Putting the modes together, with a capstone
  • Module 7: Continuing development
